LanguageData.kuro.description:
She is a dog-eared ninja, but she is Shiro's younger sister (self-proclaimed) I'm crushing on her. It’s okay for her to leave the village to search for Shiro Seems to be in a slightly misplaced land.
She's still an apprentice ninja, but her attack power is very high If you fail to persuade, be prepared to die.
